name: Question 10
problem: The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=3,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 5\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $2.$ Find $f(x).$
worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=3$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 2\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=2,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =2(x-3)(x-5\text{i})(x-(-5\text{i})) \\  & =2(x-3)(x-5\text{i})(x+5\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x-3)(x-5\text{i})(x+5\text{i}) & = \\ 2(x-3)({x}^{2}-(5\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 2(x-3)({x}^{2}+25) & = \\ 2({x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+25x-75) & = \\ 2{x}^{3}-6{x}^{2}+50x-150 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=2{x}^{3}-6{x}^{2}+50x-150.$

Question 10
?

The cubic polynomial f(x) has roots x1=3,x2,3=±5i, and the coefficient of the cubic term is 2. Find f(x).

a
x3−3x2+25x−75
b
x3+6x2+50x+150
c
2x3−6x2+20x−15
d
2x3+6x2+50x+10
e
2x3−6x2+50x−150
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since f(x) has roots x1=3 and x2,3=±2i, and the coefficient of the cubic term is a=2, we can write the polynomial as follows:

f(x)=a(x−x1)(x−x2)(x−x3)=2(x−3)(x−5i)(x−(−5i))=2(x−3)(x−5i)(x+5i)

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

2(x−3)(x−5i)(x+5i)=2(x−3)(x2−(5i)2)=2(x−3)(x2+25)=2(x3−3x2+25x−75)=2x3−6x2+50x−150.

Therefore, f(x)=2x3−6x2+50x−150.
